combats.encounter: Steam and dust creatures at the tower pool
combats.note: The table alternates enemy actions and one turn per participating PC, allowing flexible order within the party turn. Kenzo continues meditating upstairs and does not join the fight.

entries.summary: Three creatures blast Seeker and Riswynn with scalding breath, requiring three Dexterity saves each. Seeker takes 7 fire damage and Riswynn 5. Seeker makes three Constitution saves and loses concentration on Heat Metal.
entries.note: Individual Dexterity-save results are not spoken; the aggregate damage is resolved.

entries.summary: Disengages and retreats around the corner into the tower without opportunity attacks.

Closes and hits a steam creature with his sword for 9 damage, using Green-Flame Blade instead of the proposed Booming Blade. The additional 4 fire damage has no effect as the flames merge into the steam.
Shoots a steam creature with advantage/Steady Aim and Sneak Attack for 15 damage, bursting it. Its explosion deals 3 fire damage each to Riswynn and Delwath.

Disengages and retreats five squares, then casts Spiritual Weapon as a bonus action. Its hammer hits a steam creature and staggers it. The DM retracts the opportunity attacks, including a critical hit for 5 fire and 4 slashing damage, after correcting the action economy.
Hisses beyond reach, drives the steam creatures forward, and begins another effect in the pool.
Two advance toward Delwath and the others around the corner; both claw attacks miss.
Declares a reaction after the enemy attacks; its specific effect is not stated.
Hits a steam creature with Booming Blade for 7 damage; the DM confirms another 1d8 if it moves. No movement-trigger damage is subsequently stated.
Shoots the uninjured steam creature for 16 damage.
Fires his crossbow at the nearby creature and misses.
Her first attack misses. Spiritual Weapon then hits and kills the steam creature closest to the group; Delwath makes a Dexterity save against its explosion and takes 1 fire damage.
entries.note: The first attack’s weapon and the Dexterity save result are not explicitly identified.

entries.summary: Three wind-and-dust creatures coalesce near the pool and rush the party; the guardian subsequently sinks back into the water.
Exhales blinding dust, requiring Dexterity saves from Riswynn, Seeker and Delwath; Delwath is blinded. A dust creature’s claw attack on him misses despite his inability to see.
entries.note: The transcript does not separately announce Riswynn’s or Seeker’s save results.

entries.summary: The wounded surviving steam creature claws blinded Delwath for 3 slashing and 1 fire damage. The DM allows a fresh save at the end of his turn to clear the dust.
Kills the last steam creature. Delwath succeeds on a Dexterity save without disadvantage and avoids the explosion; two dust creatures also dodge it. Her Spiritual Weapon attack misses.
entries.note: The attack that kills the steam creature is not named.

entries.summary: Shoots the dust creature beside Delwath; the arrow hits and seriously wounds it. Damage is not spoken.
Abandons the proposed conjured broom and crossbow attack; puts on his own goggles, disengages, and retreats.
Disengages and retreats four squares, then succeeds on the new save and clears the blindness.
Advance on Riswynn and Wellby. Two attack Riswynn: one hits for 3 damage and one misses. The attack on Wellby also misses.
Hits with Shatterstorm for 6 damage. Her intended Spiritual Weapon follow-up is postponed by interface trouble and has no recorded resolution on this turn.
Moves up, hits and kills a dust creature. He succeeds on the Constitution save against its bursting dust and avoids effects.
Moves and shoots a wounded dust creature, killing it. Riswynn succeeds on the Constitution save against its death burst.
Casts Vicious Mockery on the remaining dust creature. It succeeds on its Wisdom save, negating the proposed 1 psychic damage.
Claws at Riswynn and misses.
Hits with Shatterstorm, leaving the creature alive, then kills it with Spiritual Weapon. It bursts into dust; the DM waives further rolling and narrates her clearing her eyes.

ending.summary: All three steam and three dust creatures are defeated. The water guardian remains alive and agitated under the pool’s surface; the dislodged sphere remains nearby.
